name: Maximalist Pop
oneLiner: Too much, on purpose: saturated color fields, oversized type, overlapping shapes, and a rhythm that never gets bored.

effects.noise: 5% halftone dots over flat color blocks only
effects.shapes: one or two oversized circles or arcs bleeding off-canvas per section

motion.reducedMotion: no marquee, no float; keep color and layout

primary.base: height: 52px; padding: 0 28px; border: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-family: 'Space Grotesk', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #1B0A2A

lime.base: height: 52px; padding: 0 28px; border: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 999px; background: #C6F91F; color: #1B0A2A; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #1B0A2A

default.base: position: relative; padding: 28px; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); border: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-border); box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 #1B0A2A; overflow: hidden

color-block.base: padding: 32px; border-radius: 32px; background: #D6C6FF; border: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-border)

default.base: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 999px; background: #C6F91F; color: #1B0A2A; border: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-border); font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; transform: rotate(-3deg)

display: flex; gap: 32px; padding: 14px 0; overflow: hidden; border-top: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-border); font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; white-space: nowrap
font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', Archivo, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(3rem, 9vw, 7rem); font-weight: 800; line-height: 0.86; letter-spacing: -0.04em; text-wrap: balance

do: Commit to three saturated colors plus ink; repeat them in blocks, shapes, and type.
Break the grid with one oversized shape or type block per section.
Set headlines bigger than feels comfortable, then let body copy stay calm at 16–17px.
Use a thick ink outline and hard offset shadow to keep elements from dissolving into color.
dont: Do not let color fields sit directly behind body text without a solid plate.
Do not use more than two rotated elements per viewport; rotation is seasoning.
Do not layer halftone over photography and gradients and shadows simultaneously.
Do not animate more than one looping element at a time.
antiPatterns: Bright colors with pale 14px text on top — maximalism that is unreadable is just noise.
Every card rotated and shadowed, so the page has no anchor and the eye cannot land.
Pop palette on a conventional enterprise layout with no editorial decisions.

notes: Saturated pink and lime backgrounds need ink text; white on lime fails at 1.9:1.
Marquees must pause on hover and focus and stop entirely under prefers-reduced-motion.
Rotated cards should keep their hit area axis-aligned; transform the visual, not the interaction box.
